description: `test_mean` cannot distinguish correct float division from a floor-division regression because the test input [1, 2, 3] produces an evenly-divisible mean (2.0), which would pass identically with floor division (//). Recommend adding a test case with non-integer mean, e.g. mean([1, 2]) == 1.5
rationale: Directly verified by executing both correct and floor-division implementations against the test input and observing identical outcomes. Test input does not exercise true float division.
evidence: mean([1, 2, 3]) == 2.0 whether using / or //; mean([1, 2]) would be 1.5 with / but 1 with //, making the distinction observable.
